purpose: Provide append-only confirmed execution evidence so historical actual positions and actual-live portfolio heat can be reconstructed without treating signal suggestions as fills.
invariants: signalEventId must never substitute for executionEventId
cross-event sharesBefore must equal prior confirmed sharesAfter for the same symbol
corrections append a new event and reference a prior event; prior execution evidence is never overwritten
current mutable position snapshots do not backfill missing historical execution events
nonGoals: reconstruct pre-ledger history from suggested shares
implementationBoundary: Any shared Production D1/API/storage wiring is Class B proposal-first and requires explicit owner approval. The research schema/test harness alone is Class A.
